note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Servers are started hidden by prepare (helper C:\lab\mgnet\svc.ps1) and their logs are shown with Get-Content/Select-String. Local screens first, then the Azure ones. Azure steps in browser screens list the terminal commands to run beside the portal. Mask app name, host and subscription.
prepare: dotnet tool restore
dotnet build ProjectRequests.slnx -v q --nologo
& $env:MG_SVC stop -Name ep04-api
Remove-Item src\ProjectRequests.Api\requests.db* -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Push-Location src\ProjectRequests.Api; dotnet dotnet-ef database update --context SqliteRequestsDbContext; Pop-Location
& $env:MG_SVC start -Name ep04-api -Project (Resolve-Path 'src\ProjectRequests.Api').Path -Urls http://localhost:5207 -Port 5207

$shim = 'C:\lab\mgnet\bin'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $shim | Out-Null; if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $shim 'zip'))) { [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $shim 'zip'), "#!/bin/bash`n# zip shim (Git Bash has no zip): called as: zip -qr <out.zip> .`n/c/Windows/System32/tar.exe -a -cf `"`$2`" .`n") }; if (-not (Get-Command jq -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { winget install --id jqlang.jq -e --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements | Out-Null }; $env:PATH = "C:\Program Files\Git\bin;$shim;$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\WinGet\Links;$env:PATH"

$env:RG = 'rg-mglab-net-04'; $af = 'C:\lab\mgnet\ep04-app.txt'; if (-not (Test-Path $af)) { "contoso-requests-$(Get-Random -Minimum 1000 -Maximum 9999)" | Set-Content $af }; $env:APP = (Get-Content $af).Trim()
az account show --query name -o none 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { az login -o none }  # owner signs in (lab subscription, labadmin)
bash ./deploy/deploy-appservice.sh
$h = az webapp show -g rg-mglab-net-04 -n $env:APP --query defaultHostName -o tsv
bash ./deploy/local-demo.sh https://$h | Out-Null

screens.name: startup-validation
prepare: & $env:MG_SVC stop -Name ep04-api
screens.note: Expected: 'Hosting failed to start' and the OptionsValidationException for Notifications:WebhookUrl; the host does not start. $LASTEXITCODE is -532462766 (0xE0434352, an unhandled .NET exception) on Windows, not the 134 of the Linux output in deploy/startup-validation.output.txt; the narration says no number.

screens.name: azure-log-stream
steps: Open the web app (name in C:\lab\mgnet\ep04-app.txt) > Monitoring > Log stream (Application logs / filesystem)
Wait for the one-minute tick: 'Digest worker run: 2 pending request(s)', 'Digest: 2 request(s) waiting more than 0 day(s) for a decision', 'FIN: 1 request(s), 12,000 total', 'OPS: ...'
Alternative in a terminal: az webapp log tail -g rg-mglab-net-04 -n $env:APP

screens.name: azure-validation
steps: Keep the web app's Log stream open in the browser
In a terminal in the episode folder (after: $env:RG='rg-mglab-net-04'; $env:APP=<app name>): bash ./deploy/deploy-appservice.sh break  (sets Notifications__Channel=webhook; the app restarts)
Log stream: 'Hosting failed to start' and the OptionsValidationException for 'WebhookUrl'; browsing to /healthz shows the App Service error page
Then: bash ./deploy/deploy-appservice.sh fix and wait until 'Digest worker run' is logged again

prepare_local: Use-DotNetSdk -Channel 10.0   # kit helper: uses the installed .NET 10 SDK, else installs it into C:\MGLab\dotnet (no admin)
if (Test-Path 'C:\lab\mgnet\svc.ps1') { & 'C:\lab\mgnet\svc.ps1' stop -Name ep04-api }   # an API left from an earlier take keeps its data and locks bin: the screen prepare starts a fresh one
dotnet tool restore; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'dotnet tool restore failed' }
dotnet build ProjectRequests.slnx -v q --nologo; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'dotnet build failed' }
